Building and bases

Solo building: strengthen the core before the outer layers

With limited solo resources, put the Tool Cupboard deep inside the core. Upgrade the core structures to stone first, then gradually to metal, while strengthening the doors. Add outer defensive layers once the core is secure. Tuck furnaces into corners to leave walking room. The author's design uses an entrance buffer room to reduce direct exposure of the interior when checking outside.
